items.exampleEn: Can I have a clean towel?
items.exampleZh: 可以給我一條乾淨的毛巾嗎？

items.exampleEn: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
There are some flowers in the vase.
They live in a big house near the park.
items.exampleZh: 他們住在公園附近的一棟大房子裡。

items.sentenceEn: The towel is in the bathroom.

items.audioEn: Can you take out the garbage? It is by the door.
items.audioZh: 你可以把垃圾拿出去倒嗎？垃圾在門邊。

items.sentenceEn: There is a vase on the table.

items.stemEn: I take a shower in the ____.
Please open the ____. Someone is here.

items.passageEn: My house is not big, but I love it. There are three rooms and one bathroom. In the living room, there is a big sofa and a vase of flowers. Every night, I take out the garbage. Then I sit on the sofa and watch TV. It is good to be home.
items.passageZh: 我的房子不大，但我很喜歡。房子有三個房間和一間浴室。客廳裡有一張大沙發和一瓶花。每天晚上我都會去倒垃圾，然後坐在沙發上看電視。待在家真好。

questions.questionZh: 說話者每天晚上做什麼家事？

referenceEn: I will be at home tonight.
rubricZh: 「在家」可寫 at home、be home、stay home 等
時態合理即可（例如 am、will be）

items.instructionZh: 用 room 造一個句子，描述你的房間。
referenceEn: My room is small but clean.
There is a big bed in my room.
rubricZh: room 前面加所有格或冠詞（例如 my room、a big room）
可用 There is…、My room is…、My room has… 等來描述
